A serializer-associated instance reference lazily resolves resource bytes, which are then interpreted by a TypeID-specific Cell schema; ownership linkage is not the content wire schema.
World and populate references feed cell definitions, population metadata, model-key derivation, and presentation preload; procedural placement and exact runtime selection remain inferred.

major_relationships.to: cBuilding, cLayoutSlot, cGameData, and owner state

Exit A and select B through SetActiveModeAt/messages.

supported_survival_claims.claim: cCellSerializableData is the explicit Cell runtime serializable state holder and contains progression, unlocked-part, counter, difficulty, mission, and telemetry fields.
supported_survival_claims.qualification: Per-field emission and round trip are unknown.

supported_survival_claims.qualification: No state-survival rule follows from lifecycle ordering.

supported_survival_claims.qualification: Initialization is not save/load; progression reset/default behavior remains unknown.
